_comment: Pinned public Delhi transit datasets. Files land in data/raw/transit/<dataset>/ (git-ignored). scripts/advisor_fetch_data.py downloads and verifies every sha256 below; nothing is synthetic.

otd_bus.title: Delhi bus static GTFS (DTC + DIMTS cluster buses)
otd_bus.publisher: Open Transit Data Delhi (otd.delhi.gov.in), Transport Dept., GNCTD with IIIT-Delhi
otd_bus.mirror: github.com/ethanc8/delhi-gtfs @ ce9586990a5474f3e4e02b876823fc4cd058e1db (byte copy of OTD GTFS.zip; the mirror only extended calendar.txt end_date)
otd_bus.notes: OTD states the stop_times arrival/departure values are rough estimates generated assuming a constant travel speed. Fares come from the feed's fare_rules/fare_attributes (official stage fares).

dmrc.title: Delhi Metro static GTFS (DMRC)
dmrc.mirror: github.com/KunalK0a2/Delhi_Metro_Route_Planner @ adc43e1d83e1619a42790e692ef3752b31b67eee (stop_times/stops/shapes are byte-identical to the OTD copy in ethanc8/delhi-gtfs)
dmrc.vintage: OTD release of 10 Aug 2023 (262 stations, 36 route patterns)
dmrc.notes: Times are DMRC's approximate schedule. The feed holds weekday trips and only a few Saturday trips and no Sunday service; on weekends the advisor uses the weekday timetable and says so.

rail.title: Indian Railways stations, trains and schedules (filtered to passenger/MEMU trains inside Delhi)
rail.publisher: DataMeet community (github.com/datameet/railways), compiled from Indian Railways enquiry data
rail.vintage: Compiled 2016; Northern Railway has re-timed and re-numbered some passenger/MEMU services since
rail.notes: Running days are not in the dataset, so trains are treated as daily. Only Pass/MEMU/DEMU/EMU trains and only consecutive stops inside the Delhi service area are used.

places.title: Delhi boundary and municipal ward localities
places.publisher: DataMeet Municipal Spatial Data (github.com/datameet/Municipal_Spatial_Data), scraped from the Delhi ward map on ArcGIS Online; CC BY-SA 2.5 India
places.vintage: Ward boundaries as published in the repository (updated Nov 2023)
places.notes: The NCT boundary decides which start/end points are accepted. 270+ ward names are offline place names (e.g. Lajpat Nagar, Karol Bagh). Other addresses and landmarks come from OpenStreetMap through the online geocoder when the server has internet.
